soup_config_used:
# Script model (D-7.5): LoRA SFT of Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with Soup (soup-cli 0.76.1).
# Paths are filled in by training/kaggle/jobs/script_sft.py. Keys checked in Soup's schema.py.
base: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
task: sft
data:
  train: /kaggle/working/sft/train.jsonl
  format: chatml
  val_split: 0.03
  max_length: 3072
  train_on_responses_only: true
training:
  epochs: 2
  lr: 2.0e-4
  batch_size: 1  # 4 ran out of memory on a T4: logits of 4 x 3072 x 151,936 vocab (D-7.5)
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 16  # effective batch 16
  seed: 7
  quantization: none
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  lora:
    r: 16
    alpha: 32
output: /kaggle/working/adapter

train: pg2542: A Doll's House : a play
pg844: The Importance of Being Earnest: A Trivial Comedy for Serious People
pg854: A Woman of No Importance
val: pg1756: Uncle Vanya: Scenes from Country Life in Four Acts

environment: 3.12.3 2.14.1+cu130 True 5.20.1 0.21.2 (python torch cuda transformers peft); soup-cli 0.76.1
